Title: Warning! Possible spoilers for Heirs to the Blood! and an inquiry of permission from the LSJ

Messages.Author: Mr. Moonshine
Messages.Body:
Hi!

The subject is what it is, since it's not possible to change the
subject after posting - it's a contingency plan of mine ;) my
apologies if this thread does not grow further and all the readers
come here to waste their time before this one fades into obscurity!

That being said, the question what I would like to ask from the dear
Mr. LSJ is that is it permissible to disclose here information about
the upcoming cards for the HttB expansion? I saw a tiny fraction of a
visual spoiler during the Palma EC, and I still remember (almost)
perfectly at least one of the cards there - will the folks at WW be
thoroughly annoyed if I were to (ab)use that information by posting it
here to the oohs and aahs of my fellow players, titillating further
their anticipation about the future set?

best regards
Mika (the la familia guy from the EC)

Sure, disclose away. (assuming you mean stuff I showed.)
